correctness.rationale: For each n, the two-color-collapse lemma and rightmost-three-colors obstruction establish that a nonfixed suffix has precisely two extensions preserving fixation depth and one increasing it by one. Fixed suffixes contribute precisely 3(m+1),3m,3(m-1) states of delays 0,1,2. These exhaustive disjoint cases prove the unrestricted polynomial recurrence. The rational solution and exact mean follow by elementary algebra; the binomial-type leading generating function yields normal fluctuations. Two independent exhaustive implementations verify the whole time histogram through n=9 and n=11; finite enumeration is corroboration only.

value.rationale: The transitive tournament is the canonical dense feed-forward topology, an informative counterpoint to the oscillations of cyclic automata on undirected graphs. The all-size exact relaxation polynomial, the linear Gaussian typical clock, the sharp linear maximum, and its six exponentially rare extremal inputs give a coherent quantitative profile of how orientation changes relaxation. These data answer natural global questions on the dynamics, rather than a finite arithmetic variant or a routine restatement of eventual fixation.
